**Estimating Spring XD Development**

I'm currently breaking down the user stories into a Work Breakdown Structure. My focus is on developing a detailed effort estimate for this Spring XD/Spring Cloud Data Flow project.

**Refining Feature Scope**

I'm now detailing the implementation strategies for U2 and U6, considering how to manage logging configurations and the single-node admin SPI. My estimates are starting to solidify as I map these requirements to actionable tasks.

**Developing Diego Integration**

My focus has shifted to integrating Diego-based implementations for the XD Admin SPI, specifically for running data pipelines on CF Lattice/Diego. I'm also investigating how Spring Cloud Stream modules can self-register with service discovery for runtime orchestration.

**Estimating New Tasks**

I'm now estimating the effort for refactoring message-bus components into a dedicated `spring-bus` repository and extracting type conversion logic into `spring-cloud-dataflow`. I'm also detailing the work for integrating new serialization codecs and finalizing the single-node Admin SPI implementation.

**Estimating Remaining Work**

I'm now focusing on estimating the remaining tasks, including unit/integration tests for the Diego/Receptor implementation, and investigating Spring Cloud Stream self-registration. I'm also performing a final effort check and refining architectural decisions, particularly the modularization of Spring XD.

**Refining Technical Details**

I'm now solidifying technical details around logging configuration, specifically how the `xd.log.dir` property will function with fallbacks. I'm also finalizing the unified `ModuleLauncher` mechanism for Admin SPI across single-node and Cloud Foundry environments, targeting Java 17 and Spring Framework 6.

**Validating Effort Estimates**

I'm now performing a thorough review of the estimated hours against the defined activities, ensuring alignment with the JSON schema requirements. This includes validating effort for message-bus extraction, type conversion, codec implementation, and the various Admin SPI integrations.

technical_and_design_decisions: Refactor Spring XD architecture by extracting message bus, serialization codecs, and type converters into modular components (spring-bus and spring-cloud-dataflow) to support decoupled dependencies.
Expose a configurable logging directory property (e.g., xd.log.dir) in Spring XD configuration files and startup scripts, defaulting to ${xd.home}/logs when unspecified.
Standardize Admin SPI implementations on the ModuleLauncher abstraction for both local single-node (SingleNodeAdmin) and Diego/Receptor (CF Lattice) execution environments.
Fix Sqoop module Teradata integration by updating connection manager instantiation, handling classloader issues, and preventing NullPointerExceptions when the native JDBC driver is used directly.
assumptions: Development and testing environments have access to Java 17+ and Spring Framework build infrastructure.
A test instance or simulator for CF Lattice / Diego Receptor API is available for developing and testing the Diego Admin SPI implementation.
The target repositories (spring-bus and spring-cloud-dataflow) exist or are established as part of the ecosystem refactoring.
Teradata JDBC drivers and Hortonworks Teradata connector binaries can be acquired or mocked for unit and integration testing.

activities.activity_name: Resolve Sqoop Teradata Driver NPE & Connection Manager Support
activities.activity_description: Investigate and fix the NullPointerException occurring with direct Teradata JDBC driver invocation in the Sqoop module, ensuring correct classloading and support for both TeraDriver and TeradataConnManager.
Modify Spring XD log configuration files (Log4j/Logback) and startup scripts to allow external overrides for the log directory (e.g., /var/logs/spring-xd for RPM installations).
Migrate the message-bus module from the Spring XD repository into the spring-bus repository, configure Maven publishing, and update Spring XD to consume it as an external dependency.

activities.activity_name: Migrate Input/Output Type Conversion to spring-cloud-dataflow
activities.activity_description: Extract tuple and payload type conversion classes into spring-cloud-dataflow to enable custom module domain object production and consumption.
Move serialization codec implementations (such as Kryo and Tuple codecs) to spring-bus and update Spring XD module dependencies.

activities.activity_name: Develop Singlenode XD Admin SPI Implementation
activities.activity_description: Design and implement a single-JVM Singlenode Admin SPI based on ModuleLauncher to enable running data pipelines locally.

activities.activity_name: Develop Diego/Receptor XD Admin SPI Implementation
activities.activity_description: Implement the XD Admin SPI for CF Lattice / Diego using the Receptor API and ModuleLauncher to deploy and manage data pipeline modules on Diego.

activities.activity_name: Spike & Prototype s-c-s Module Self-Registration with Service Discovery
activities.activity_description: Investigate Spring Cloud Stream module self-registration mechanisms with service discovery services on Cloud Foundry and prototype orchestration within Spring XD runtime.
Perform end-to-end integration testing across refactored dependencies, local singlenode admin, and external module execution.
